headers.//: Vercel serves everything with max-age=0, must-revalidate by default, so even an unchanged image costs a conditional request on every page load. These files are only ever replaced under a new name — the portfolio stills are regenerated as story-<slug>.webp and the logo as logo-<size>.webp — so there is nothing to revalidate and a year is safe. Anything edited in place (the stylesheets, the scripts) is deliberately left on the default.
